Lok Sabha Passes Bill, Government Clarifies UPI Charges

The Lok Sabha passed the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, which allows the government to permit charges on UPI transactions. The government has clarified that UPI payments will remain free for consumers. However, a nominal charge may be applied to certain merchants and large transactions. This clarification came after concerns arose regarding potential fees for UPI users following the bill's passage. Payment platforms like PhonePe and Razorpay have supported selective charges for large merchants.
